Accessibility

Please contact Inter as soon as possible (and by 31 May 2027 at the latest).

THE INTER CAMPSITE

It is part of campsite Inferno. Access to the Inter campsite requires a valid festival wristband and camping wristband. This dedicated zone includes accessible showers, washbasins and toilets. The Inter camping is open for combi ticket holders from 3 pm on Wednesday 16 June 2027.

IN THE FESTIVAL ARENA

The main stages, the River Stage and the Hall have raised platforms for wheelchair users and persons with a disability. One carer can join them on the platform.
